Juniper Lane Studio

Brand at a glance. Maturity: standard. Role: organization.

Colors

#2F5D50
palette.primary --juniperlanestudio-palette-primary

Juniper green. The studio color: buttons, the logo, and section bands.

Avoid: small text on blush

#FFFFFF
palette.onPrimary --juniperlanestudio-palette-on-primary

Labels and icons on juniper green (button text, reversed logo).

#2E6B58
palette.link --juniperlanestudio-palette-link

Text links on paper, white, and the card wash. A touch brighter than juniper so links stand out from text.

#2B2B2B
palette.charcoal --juniperlanestudio-palette-charcoal

Body text and headings. Softer than pure black on warm paper.

#FAF6F0
palette.paper --juniperlanestudio-palette-paper

Warm paper. The default page background for the website, proposals, and invoices.

#FFFFFF
palette.white --juniperlanestudio-palette-white

Pure white. Photo mats, print margins, and forms where paper would look off-white.

#E8B4A8
palette.blush --juniperlanestudio-palette-blush

Blush accent. Thin rules, small shapes, and photo frames. Never use for text or behind white text.

Avoid: text; button fills; behind white text

#E6EFEA
palette.wash --juniperlanestudio-palette-wash

Soft sage wash. Card and callout backgrounds, like pricing boxes in a proposal.
